messages:
sean_support: Customer on Dedicated reported streaming outputs get truncated after a reconnect. They see the stream stop mid-token and no final 'done' event. Happens in our Python SDK async iterator when client cancels and then reconnects.
elaine: Ugh. Any repro yet? Which SDK version and runtime?

sean_support: Repro steps below, minimal:
```
# Python 3.11, redwood-sdk==0.9.2
async with client.stream("gpt-lite") as s:
    async for chunk in s:
        print(chunk.text, end="")
# If we cancel the consumer task (signal) and immediately recreate stream, last tokens are missing
```
Observed: the second stream returns partial sentence then stops. No 200/EOF event. Customer on paid Dedicated, repeated calls during retry causing perceived duplicate billing.

alex_r: Could be a race between connection close + iterator finalization. SDK resumes by reusing last-seen cursor; if the upstream sent the final frame during the reconnect window, iterator might not emit it. Have logs?

sean_support: Attached quick log snippet from customer (sanitized):
```
[2026-03-15T14:02:10Z] stream-start id=abc123
[2026-03-15T14:02:17Z] client-cancel signal=SIGINT
[2026-03-15T14:02:17Z] reconnect start
[2026-03-15T14:02:17Z] upstream: final_chunk token_id=987 flags=last
[2026-03-15T14:02:17Z] reconnect complete
# No emitter for token_id=987
```

elaine: That log is telling. If upstream final_chunk arrives during reconnect, our client should buffer or re-request missing seq. Looks like we didn't handle out-of-order final event.

alex_r: Quick workaround for customer: set a short drain/wait before reconnect (e.g., 200-500ms) or disable auto-resume and do manual resume with last_event_id. I'll open a repro locally.

deploy-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-0315-47 (assigned to eng-runtime)

sean_support: Customer asked for timeline + ETA and wants a patch. They can tolerate workaround for now.

elaine: I'll escalate to eng-runtime, include the logs and minimal script. Tagging @alex_r for triage. Keep customer on the loop with INC-2026-0315-47 :eyes:

alex_r: Confirmed local repro. Root cause is iterator finalization dropping events when reconnection overlaps arrival of terminal event. I'll draft a fix to buffer terminal events until handshake completes or to re-request by last_cursor. Will post PR and temporary patch tomorrow.

sean_support: Thanks — will relay to customer and push workaround. :thumbsup:
